z-m-38-03.title: N'ngwọta Minjun nke √(x+2)=x, ahịrị kedu na-ezighị ezi?
z-m-38-03.topic: Ngwọta nke irrational equation na extraneous solutions (ọnọdụ nke irrational expressions)
z-m-38-03.goal: N'ngwọta nke na-amịkọrịta akụkụ abụọ nke irrational equation, chọta ahịrị ebe nlele na-efu, kọwaa ihe mere a ji tụfuo otu ngwọta, ma mepụta nha ebe otu ihe ahụ na-eme.
z-m-38-03.material: x bụ ọnụọgụ n'eziokwu. Minjun doziri nha √(x+2) = x (gụọ: 'square root nke x gbakwunyere 2 hà x') ma dee ọrụ ahụ n'okpuru. Onye nkụzi kwuru, “Ọ nwere ike ọ gaghị abụ naanị otu azịza, ya mere lee ma ahịrị ọ bụla nke ngwọta na-enweghị nlele.”
z-m-38-03.thinking.0: Ịlele echiche nke ngwọta ahịrị ahịrị
z-m-38-03.thinking.1: Ịkewa ihe nzọụkwụ nlele kwesịrị ilele
z-m-38-03.thinking.2: Ịmepụta nsogbu ọhụrụ nwere otu nhazi n'onwe gị
z-m-38-03.prereq.1: Irrational expressions (n'ime square root bụ 0 ma ọ bụ karịa, uru nke square root bụkwa 0 ma ọ bụ karịa)
z-m-38-03.prereq.3: Mmekọrịta n'etiti mgbọrọgwụ na coefficients (nchikota na ngwaahịa nke mgbọrọgwụ abụọ)
z-m-38-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ otu ahịrị nke ngwọta nwere ihe na-ezighị ezi. (Gụọ ahịrị site n'1.)
z-m-38-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye x = 2 na x = −1 nke ọ bụla n'nha mbụ √(x+2) = x, ma gbakọọ akụkụ aka ekpe na akụkụ aka nri n'iche.
z-m-38-03.s.s1.line.0: Ịmịkọrịta akụkụ abụọ n'onwe ha na-enye x + 2 = x²
z-m-38-03.s.s1.line.2: Ya mere x = 2 ma ọ bụ x = −1
z-m-38-03.s.s1.line.3: Mgbe x = −1, n'ime mgbọrọgwụ bụ −1 + 2 = 1, nke na-adịghị mma, ya mere uru abụọ ahụ bụ ngwọta nke nha a
z-m-38-03.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị nke 4 na-ezighị ezi. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye x = −1 n'nha mbụ, akụkụ aka ekpe bụ √1 = 1 ma akụkụ aka nri bụ −1, ya mere ha dị iche. Ihe a ga-elele abụghị ma “n'ime mgbọrọgwụ adịghị mma” kama ma “nha mbụ na-ejide.” Mgbakọ n'ahịrị 1 ruo 3 ziri ezi.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ nkọwa niile ziri ezi maka ihe mere x = −1 ji fọdụ na ngwọta.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee oke uru √(x+2) nwere ike were, ma chee ọnọdụ ọ na-enye x n'akụkụ aka nri.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye nha na-enye x + 2 = x² n'otu ụzọ ahụ n'√(x+2) = −x.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.a: Mgbe e mịkọrịtara n'onwe ha, √(x+2)=x na √(x+2)=−x abụọ na-aghọ otu x+2=x², ya mere enweghị ike ịkewa ha
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.a: Nkọwa a ghọtara na ịmịkọrịta n'onwe ha na-ehichapụ ozi banyere akara.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.b: Mgbe ịmịkọrịta n'onwe ha, e nwere mgbe niile otu ngwọta ọzọ karịa n'nha mbụ, ya mere a ga-atụfu mgbe niile otu n'ngwọta e nwetara site n'ịmịkọrịta n'onwe ha
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.b: Ịmịkọrịta n'onwe ha anaghị agbakwunye otu ngwọta ọzọ mgbe niile. Nke a na-eme izugbe n'enweghị ịnwale ya n'onwe gị n'nha dịka √x = 2.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.c: E nwere njehie mgbakọ n'ịme factoring (x−2)(x+1)=0 nke mepụtara ngwọta ọzọ
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.c: Factoring ziri ezi. Nke a na-ewere eziokwu na quadratic equation nwere ngwọta abụọ dịka njehie mgbakọ.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.d: Ọ zuru ezu na x+2 n'ime mgbọrọgwụ adịghị mma, ya mere ngwọta ọ bụla nwere x ≥ −2 ga-adị ọbụlagodi na ọ sitere n'ịmịkọrịta n'onwe ha
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.d: Ọnọdụ dị n'ime mgbọrọgwụ dị mkpa ma ọ bụghị nke zuru ezu. Ị ga-elele n'iche ma nha mbụ na-ejide.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.o.e: √(x+2) bụ 0 ma ọ bụ karịa, ya mere x n'nha mbụ ga-abụkwa 0 ma ọ bụ karịa, ma nha e mịkọrịtara n'onwe ya enweghị ọnọdụ a
z-m-38-03.s.s2.r.e: Nkọwa a ghọtara na ọnọdụ na square root bụ 0 ma ọ bụ karịa na-emepụtakwa ọnọdụ n'akụkụ aka nri.
z-m-38-03.s.s2.explain: a na e na-akọwa otu ihe ahụ site n'akụkụ dị iche. Ịmịkọrịta n'onwe ha na-ehichapụ ozi akara (a), ya mere ọnọdụ 'x ≥ 0' nke nha mbụ nwere pụrụ (e). b bụ izugbe na-ezighị ezi, c na-ezighị ezi n'ihi na factoring ziri ezi, d bụ ọnọdụ dị mkpa ma ọ naghị agwa gị n'onwe ya ma uru bụ ngwọta.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.prompt: Mgbe a bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma, ịmịkọrịta akụkụ abụọ nke nha √(x+a) = x n'onwe ha na-enye x² − x − a = 0. Mee uru a dị iche 3 nke mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke quadratic equation a bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. (N'ikpe ahụ, otu n'mgbọrọgwụ abụọ ahụ abụghị ngwọta nke nha mbụ.)
z-m-38-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kpọọ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ ahụ r na s, ma dee ka nchikota r + s na ngwaahịa rs si jikọta na a.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.hint.1: Nwaa obere ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma maka a otu otu, nwalee ma x² − x − a na-eme factoring, ma chọọ pattern n'etiti uru a nke na-arụ ọrụ.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.ok.c1: a bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.fail.c1: a ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nke bụ 1 ma ọ bụ karịa.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Mgbọrọgwụ abụọ nke x²−x−a=0 bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu (discriminant 1+4a bụ perfect square).
z-m-38-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Mgbọrọgwụ nke x²−x−a=0 abụghị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Lelee ma discriminant 1+4a bụ square nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu ụfọdụ.
z-m-38-03.s.s3.explain: Kpọọ mgbọrọgwụ abụọ ahụ r na s. Mgbe ahụ r + s = 1 na rs = −a < 0, ya mere otu mgbọrọgwụ dị mma ma otu adịghị mma. Mgbọrọgwụ adịghị mma apụghị ịbụ ngwọta nke nha mbụ n'ihi √(x+a) ≥ 0. Ka mgbọrọgwụ abụọ ahụ bụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, r(1−r) = −a, ya mere a = r(r−1), na a = 2 (mgbọrọgwụ 2, −1), 6 (mgbọrọgwụ 3, −2), 12 (mgbọrọgwụ 4, −3), 20 (mgbọrọgwụ 5, −4), ...

z-m-38-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ọ bụrụ na a bụ 0, ọ bụghị ọrụ quadratic.

z-m-38-02.title: A na-edozi eserese naanị n'ihi na isi abụọ nwere otu elu?
z-m-38-02.topic: Ịkpebi usoro nke ọrụ quadratic, na ma ọnọdụ ndị ahụ zuru ezu
z-m-38-02.goal: Maka ọrụ quadratic f(x)=ax²+bx+c nwere f(0)=3 na f(4)=3, hazie ihe a ga-agbakwunye ka a na-edozi usoro n'otu, ma maka ọnọdụ ndị anaghị edozi ya, wuo ọtụtụ usoro na-emezu ọnọdụ niile.
z-m-38-02.material: Maka ọrụ quadratic f(x) = ax² + bx + c (a ≠ 0; a, b, c bụ oke; gụọ dị ka: 'a x squared plus b x plus c'), a maara ihe abụọ. Eserese na-agafe isi (0, 3) na isi (4, 3). Ya bụ, f(0) = 3 na f(4) = 3. Ozi a naanị anaghị edozi usoro f n'otu. Anyị ga-enye otu ozi ọzọ.
z-m-38-02.thinking.2: Iwu ọtụtụ usoro na-emezu otu ọnọdụ ahụ
z-m-38-02.prereq.1: Itinye nhazi nke isi n'quadratic y=ax²+bx+c iji mepụta mmekọrita n'etiti ọnụọgụ
z-m-38-02.prereq.2: Eziokwu na isi abụọ nwere otu elu na-ahụ n'ụzọ ha na-adị gbasara axis ndakọrịta
z-m-38-02.prereq.3: Akara nke discriminant b²−4ac na ọnụọgụ isi ebe eserese na-ezute x-axis
z-m-38-02.s.s1.prompt: Site n'ozi dị n'okpuru, họrọ ozi niile nke “ịgbakwunye naanị otu ozi ahụ na-eme ka a na-edozi usoro nke f n'otu.”
z-m-38-02.s.s1.hint.0: Họrọ otu ozi e chere ma wuo usoro abụọ na-emezu ya ya na f(0)=3 na f(4)=3. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike iwu abụọ, ozi ahụ ezughị.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.hint.1: Buru ụzọ dee mmekọrita na-apụta n'etiti ọnụọgụ b na a mgbe f(0)=3 na f(4)=3.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-agwa gị naanị na a dị mma, ya mere ka enwere ọtụtụ uru a kwere omume. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwalee a = 1 na a = 2, ha abụọ kwere omume.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.o.b: Uru kacha pere mpe nke f bụ −1
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.b: Nhọrọ a na-amata na nke kacha pere mpe dị ma iji uru ya ọnụ na-ekwe ka ị chọta a.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.o.c: Eserese na-ezute x-axis n'isi abụọ dị iche
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.c: Nke a kwere omume ọ bụghị naanị mgbe a dị mma kamakwa mgbe ọ adịghị mma, ma ọbụlagodi maka a dị mma, ọtụtụ uru kwere omume. Ị nwalebeghị ma ọtụtụ uru a na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.d: Nhọrọ a na-amata na isi ọhụrụ na-agbakwunye otu mmekọrita ọhụrụ ọzọ n'usoro, nke na-edozi ọnụọgụ.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.r.e: Nke a na-ekwughachi ozi e nyelarị, ya mere ọ naghị agbakwunye mmekọrịta ọhụrụ. Ị ga-ekewa ozi ọhụrụ na ozi ị maralarị.
z-m-38-02.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na f(0)=3 na f(4)=3, axis of symmetry bụ x = 2 ma nkwupụta nwere udi f(x)=a(x−2)²+k. Ọ bụrụ na kacha ntakịrị bụ −1, mgbe ahụ k = −1, a>0, ma site n'f(0)=4a−1=3 anyị na-enweta a=1. Ọ bụrụ na ebe ahụ bụ (1, 0), mgbe ahụ a+k=0 na 4a+k=3, ya mere a=1 na k=−1. N'aka nke ọzọ, na “na-emepe elu” na “na-ezute n'ebe abụọ,” a nwere ike were ọtụtụ uru, ebe (4, 3) bụkwa ozi anyị maralarị.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.prompt: Mee quadratic functions dị iche 3 f(x) = ax² + bx + c nwere f(0) = 3 na f(4) = 3 nke eserese ha na-ezute x-axis n'ebe abụọ dị iche. (Tinye a, b, c.)
z-m-38-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tinye f(0)=3 na f(4)=3 n'nkwupụta, ma buru ụzọ dee mmekọrịta dị n'etiti a na b.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ozugbo ị họrọ a, a na-ekpebi b ya na ya. Mgbe ịhọrọchara a, lelee ma uru b²−4ac dị mma.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.hint.2: Nwalee uru adịghị mma nke a yana ndị dị mma.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Itinye x=0 na-enye f(0)=c, ya mere c ga-abụ 3.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Uru 16a+4b+c, nke e nwetara site n'itinye x=4, abụghị 3.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Ọ na-ezute x-axis n'ebe abụọ dị iche (discriminant dị mma).
z-m-38-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Discriminant b²−4ac adịghị mma, ya mere ọ naghị ezute x-axis n'ebe abụọ dị iche.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.explain: c = 3, ma site n'16a + 4b + 3 = 3 anyị na-enweta b = −4a. Mgbe ahụ discriminant bụ 16a² − 12a = 4a(4a − 3), nke dị mma mgbe a < 0 ma ọ bụ a > 3/4. Ya mere e nwere ọtụtụ nkwupụta na-enweghị njedebe na-emezu ọnọdụ niile, dịka (1, −4, 3), (2, −8, 3), (−1, 4, 3). a = 0.5 anaghị arụ ọrụ n'ihi na discriminant adịghị mma.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.prompt: N'okwu nke gị, dee ihe mere a ka na-edozighị nkwupụta n'otu ọbụlagodi mgbe anyị gbakwunyere ozi “na-ezute x-axis n'ebe abụọ dị iche.”
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tụnyere ihe dị iche n'etiti nkwupụta atọ ị mere n'elu.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lelee nke n'b na c na-agbanwe ya na ya mgbe ị gbanwere a.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị gosiri na nkwupụta ndị ị mere dị iche, site n'iji uru kpọmkwem nke a na b?
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị kọwara ihe mere ọnọdụ ndị ahụ ji aga n'ihu na-emezu ọbụlagodi mgbe a gbanwere (a na-ekpebi b site n'a)?
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ọnọdụ nke ịzute x-axis n'ebe abụọ na-aga n'ihu na-emezu ọbụlagodi ma anyị gbanwee a ka ọ bụrụ ọtụtụ uru dịka 1, 2, −1 ma tọọ b na −4a, ya mere e nwere ọtụtụ nkwupụta na-emezu ọnọdụ niile. Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere a naghị ekpebi ya n'otu.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na f(0)=3 na f(4)=3, discriminant dị mma ma mgbe a=1 ma mgbe a=2, ya mere ọtụtụ nkwupụta dị iche na-apụta. Ọnọdụ a anaghị edozi uru a.
z-m-38-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ọ ga-adị mma karịa ikwukwa banyere ikpe dịka a=−1, ebe eserese na-emepe n'ala.

z-m-38-06.title: Mgbe ngalaba na range kwụsiri ike, quadratic functions ole kwere omume?
z-m-38-06.topic: Ikpebi ọnụọgụ nke quadratic function nke ngalaba na range ya kwụsiri ike
z-m-38-06.goal: Chọta ọnụọgụ kachasị nke f(x)=a(x−1)²+k nke range ya bụ 1 ≤ y ≤ 5 n'ngalaba 0 ≤ x ≤ 3, kọwakwa ihe mere ikpe ji kewaa abụọ na ihe mere enweghị ndị ọzọ.
z-m-38-06.material: Quadratic function f(x) = a(x − 1)² + k (a ≠ 0; a na k bụ kọnstant n'ezie; a na-agụ dị ka: 'a ugboro (x wepụ 1) square tinye k') nwere ngalaba 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 na range 1 ≤ y ≤ 5. Ya bụ, n'oge a kacha nta bụ 1 ma kacha ukwuu bụ 5. Rịba ama: n'x = 0, x = 1, x = 3 n'ngalaba, ụkpụrụ function bụ a + k, k, 4a + k, n'otu n'otu. Minjun kwuru, “E nwere kacha nta, ya mere ọ na-emeghe n'elu. Ya mere e nwere naanị otu pair (a, k) kwere omume.”
z-m-38-06.thinking.1: Ịkewa n'ikpe na ilele ha n'enweghị ihapụ
z-m-38-06.thinking.2: Idee ihe mere nkwupụta na enweghị ndị ọzọ
z-m-38-06.prereq.1: Ihe ngosi nke a na udi eserese maka quadratic y=a(x−p)²+q
z-m-38-06.prereq.2: N'oge emechiri emechi, kacha ukwuu na kacha nta sitere n'ụkpụrụ dị n'vertex na ngwụcha abụọ
z-m-38-06.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ikpe kachasị kwesị ekwesị banyere okwu Minjun.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.hint.0: Dee ebe kacha ukwuu na kacha nta na-apụta n'oge 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 mgbe a dị mma na mgbe a adịghị mma.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sere eserese nwere a adịghị mma, lelee ma vertex bụ ebe kacha elu ma ọ bụ kacha ala nke oge ahụ.
z-m-38-06.s.s1.o.a: Mba. Ọbụna ma ọ na-emeghe n'okpuru, kacha nta 1 nwere ike ịpụta n'ngwụcha, ya mere e nwere ike ịnwe pair ọzọ

z-m-38-05.title: Ọ bụrụ na anyị amịkọrịta functions abụọ na-abawanye, ngwaahịa ọ̀ na-abawanyekwa mgbe niile?
z-m-38-05.topic: Increasing functions na ngwaahịa: iwu counterexamples site n'ngwaahịa nke linear functions, na ọnọdụ ebe nkwupụta na-ejide
z-m-38-05.goal: Nwalee nkwupụta “ngwaahịa nke increasing functions abụọ na-abawanye,” mee counterexamples dị iche site n'linear functions, ma họrọ ọnọdụ ebe nkwupụta na-ejide.
z-m-38-05.material: E nwere functions abụọ f na g nke domain ya bụ ọnụọgụ n'eziokwu niile. “Increasing” pụtara na ọ bụrụ na x₁ < x₂, mgbe ahụ f(x₁) < f(x₂). Seoa kwuru, “Ọ bụrụ na f na g abụọ bụ increasing functions, mgbe ahụ ngwaahịa h(x) = f(x)·g(x) bụkwa increasing function.” Seoa were f(x) = x + 1 na g(x) = 2x + 1 ma gbakọọ h n'x = 1, 2, 3. h(1) = 6, h(2) = 15, h(3) = 28.
z-m-38-05.thinking.0: Ịnwale nkwupụta (ịghara ikwupụta ya eziokwu site n'ihe atụ ole na ole)
z-m-38-05.thinking.2: Iji counterexamples sifee ma họrọ ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-ejide
z-m-38-05.prereq.1: Ihe function ịbụ increasing pụtara (ọ bụrụ na x₁<x₂, mgbe ahụ f(x₁)<f(x₂))
z-m-38-05.prereq.2: Ịgbakọ uru nke linear functions na ngwaahịa ha (x+m)(x+n)

z-m-38-05.s.s1.prompt: Ịle mgbakọ Seoa, gịnị bụ ihe kacha kwesị ekwesị ikwu banyere nkwupụta Seoa?
z-m-38-05.s.s1.hint.0: Dee oke x Seoa nwalere, ma tụnyere ya na domain niile.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.hint.1: Maka f(x) = x + 1 na g(x) = 2x + 1, chọtakwa uru h mgbe x bụ −3, −2, −1, 0.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.a: Uru h toro n'usoro n'x = 1, 2, 3, ya mere anyị na-ewere nkwupụta ahụ dịka eziokwu
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.a: Ị were eziokwu na ụkpụrụ atọ mụbara gbasaa n'ngalaba niile. Ka function bụrụ increasing, ọ ga-adị mma maka x₁<x₂ niile.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.b: Ebe f na g abụọ bụ increasing, ọ na-esochi ozugbo na product bụ increasing, ya mere enweghị mkpa ilele
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.b: Ị nabatara nkwupụta ahụ kama ịmeso ya dị ka ihe a ga-elele. N'adịghị ka nchikota, product na-emetụta site n'ihe ngosi (sign).
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.c: Ụkpụrụ x e nwalere bụ naanị nke dị mma, ya mere o siri ike ikwu na ọ bụ eziokwu tupu ịhụ ụkpụrụ n'akụkụ adịghị mma kwa
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.c: Ikpe a na-ekewa oke e nwalere na ngalaba niile, na-ekpebi ebe a ga-anwale ọzọ.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.d: Ụkpụrụ na-eto ngwa ngwa, dị ka h(3)=28, ya mere anyị nwere ike ịtụle product dị ka increasing
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.d: Ị lekwasịrị anya n'ịdị ukwuu nke ịtụnye ụkpụrụ. Ihe nkwupụta ahụ na-ekwu abụghị banyere ịdị ukwuu nke uto kama banyere ịbawanye n'x ọ bụla.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.explain: N'x = −3, −2, −1, 0, h bụ 10, 3, 0, 1. Site n'x = −3 ruo −2, h na-ebelata site na 10 ruo 3. Ihe atụ Seoa nwalere naanị akụkụ dị mma, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ịmata ma nkwupụta ahụ bụ eziokwu, n'ezie nkwupụta ahụ na-agbajikwa n'ihe atụ a.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.prompt: f(x) = x + m na g(x) = x + n (m ≤ n) abụọ bụ increasing functions. Ugbu a wuo ihe atụ ebe product h(x) = f(x)·g(x) abụghị increasing. Ya bụ, mee ka h(p) > h(q) maka ọnụọgụ abụọ p < q. Mee ihe atụ 3 nwere (m, n) dị iche.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.0: Mgbe ị họrọ m na n, mee tebụl nke ụkpụrụ h(x) n'x = −3, −2, −1, 0, 1 ma chọọ ebe ụkpụrụ na-ebelata.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.1: Mgbe ị chọtara ebe ụkpụrụ na-ebelata, dee ụkpụrụ x abụọ ahụ dị ka p na q. Gbanwee m na n ma nwalee ma (m, n) ndị ọzọ nwekwara ebe ụkpụrụ na-ebelata.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c1: m anaghị adị ukwuu karịa n (ka a ghara ịgụ otu ụzọ abụọ nke functions ugboro abụọ naanị site n'ịgbanwe aha).
z-m-38-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Biko mee ka m ≤ n (ka a ghara ịgụ otu ihe atụ ahụ ugboro abụọ mgbe f na g gbanwere ọnọdụ).
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c3: p < q mana h(p) > h(q). h abụghị increasing.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.fail.c3: h(p) adịghị ukwuu karịa h(q). Gbakọọ n'onwe gị ka ụkpụrụ nke product si agbanwe.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.explain: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na f(x) = g(x) = x (m = n = 0), mgbe ahụ h(x) = x² na h(−2) = 4 > h(−1) = 1. Ọ bụrụ na f(x) = x + 1 na g(x) = x + 3 (m = 1, n = 3), mgbe ahụ h(−3) = (−2)(0) = 0 > h(−2) = (−1)(1) = −1. Otu ihe atụ megidere zuru ezu iji gbajie nkwupụta ahụ. Ebe ụkpụrụ nke linear expressions abụọ ahụ adịghị mma, ịdị ukwuu nke product nwere ike ịdị ntakịrị ka x na-abawanye.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.prompt: Anyị chọrọ itinye ọnọdụ ka nkwupụta Seoa na-adị mma mgbe niile. Kedu ọnọdụ kwesịrị ekwesị?
z-m-38-05.s.s3.hint.0: Maka ọnọdụ ọ bụla, nwalee ma ị nwere ike iwu pair nke functions na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ mana product ha abụghị increasing.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.hint.1: Iji tụnyere f(p)g(p) na f(q)g(q) mgbe p < q, chee echiche ihe ngosi (sign) ọnụọgụ na-amụba f(p) < f(q) na g(p) < g(q) ga-enwerịrị.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.a: Eserese nke f na g abụọ na-agafe n'isi (origin) ma na-ebili gaa n'akụkụ elu aka nri
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.a: f(x) = g(x) = x bụ increasing function na-agafe n'origin, mana h(x) = x² na-ebelata maka x < 0. Ị wubeghị ihe atụ megidere iji nwalee ya.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.b: Ụkpụrụ function f(0) na g(0) n'x = 0 abụọ dị mma
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.b: Ị hapụrụ na ọ nwere ike ịdị mma naanị n'x = 0 ma adịghị mma n'x ndị ọzọ. Nwalee site na f(x) = g(x) = x + 1 n'x = −3, −2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.c: Chee echiche ngalaba dị ka e belatara ya n'akụkụ ebe x > 0
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.c: Ọbụna ma ngalaba dị mma, ụkpụrụ function nwere ike ịdịghị mma. Nwalee site na f(x) = g(x) = x − 5 n'x = 1, 2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.d: N'x ọ bụla n'ngalaba, f(x) na g(x) abụọ dị mma
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.d: Nhọrọ a na-ekewa ngalaba na ụkpụrụ function ma na-amata na ihe ngosi nke ọnụọgụ ndị a na-amụba dị mkpa mgbe a na-atụnyere products.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na p < q, mgbe ahụ 0 < f(p) < f(q) na 0 < g(p) < g(q), ya mere f(p)g(p) < f(q)g(p) < f(q)g(q). Ihe atụ megidere maka a bụ f = g = x (h bụ 4, 1 n'x = −2, −1), ihe atụ megidere maka b bụ f = g = x + 1 (h bụ 4, 1 n'x = −3, −2), ihe atụ megidere maka c bụ f = g = x − 5 (h bụ 16, 9 n'x = 1, 2).

z-m-38-01.title: Ka anyị na-agbasa ngalaba, kedu ka nke kachasị na nke kacha pere mpe si akwaga?
z-m-38-01.topic: Nke kachasị na nke kacha pere mpe nke ọrụ quadratic mgbe ngalaba gbanwere
z-m-38-01.goal: Ka ọnụ k nke ngalaba na-agbanwe, lelee site n'tebụl uru otú ebe nke kachasị na nke kacha pere mpe na-apụta (vertex ma ọ bụ ọnụ) si agbanwe, ma kwughachi amụma mbụ gị.
z-m-38-01.material: Nke a bụ ọrụ quadratic f(x) = x² − 4x + 3 (gụọ dị ka: 'x squared minus 4x plus 3'). Tọọ ngalaba na 0 ≤ x ≤ k (k bụ ọnụọgụ n'ezie dị mma), gbanwee k, ma lee nke kachasị na nke kacha pere mpe nke f n'ngalaba ahụ. Seoyeon buru amụma: “Ọ bụrụ na etiti na-aghọ sara mbara, nke kacha pere mpe na-aghọ obere karịa ma nke kachasị na-aghọ buru ibu karịa.” A na-ekpughe tebụl uru otu n'otu, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ.
z-m-38-01.thinking.0: Ịnwale amụma site n'iji tebụl uru dị ka ihe àmà
z-m-38-01.thinking.1: Idebe ma ọ bụ idegharị ikpe gị ka ozi ọhụrụ na-abata
z-m-38-01.thinking.2: Ikwu, site n'iji etiti, otú nkwubi okwu si agbanwe mgbe ọnọdụ (ngalaba) gbanwere
z-m-38-01.prereq.0: H1 nke ọrụ a bụ naanị ogo isi ike e kenyere n'mmepụta; ọ pụtaghị na usoro ọmụmụ na-etinye ọdịnaya a n'ogo 1 nke ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị. Were na a mụlarị ihe achọrọ tupu dị n'okpuru.
z-m-38-01.prereq.1: Idegharị ọrụ quadratic n'ụdị y=a(x−p)²+q iji chọta vertex (imecha square)
z-m-38-01.prereq.2: Ọdịdị nke eserese nke ọrụ quadratic na axis ndakọrịta ya
z-m-38-01.prereq.3: Ịgbakọ uru ọrụ n'onwe gị iji mee tebụl uru
z-m-38-01.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe tebụl uru otu n'otu. N'ogo ọ bụla, mee ikpe site n'data ruo ugbu a, ma mgbe data na-esote pụtara, debe ma ọ bụ degharịa ikpe ahụ. (Ngalaba bụ mgbe niile 0 ≤ x ≤ k.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dee ụzọ x na f(x) site na tebụl e kpughere, ma maa ebe uru kacha pere mpe na kachasị na-apụta.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dee ọzọ f(x) n'ụdị (x−□)²+□, ma lelee ma x ebe uru kacha pere mpe na-apụta n'ụdị ahụ dị n'ime ngalaba.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Nke a bụ tebụl uru maka k = 1 (0 ≤ x ≤ 1). Mgbe x = 0, f = 3; mgbe x = 0.5, f = 1.25; mgbe x = 1, f = 0. N'etiti a nke kacha pere mpe bụ 0 ma nke kachasị bụ 3.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ọ bụrụ na anyị na-aga n'ihu na-abawanye k karịa 1, kedu ihe ị chere ga-eme nke kacha pere mpe? (Buru amụma site n'iji naanị tebụl na usoro ruo ugbu a.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ya na tebụl atọ naanị, ma a ma b bụ amụma kwere omume. Ọ bụrụ na ị chere ọdịdị nke usoro (na-emeghe n'elu), b bụ okike; ọ bụrụ na ị lere naanị ọchịchọ nke uru na-aghọ obere, ị na-enweta a. Ka anyị nwalee ya site na tebụl na-esote.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ka k na-abawanye, nke kacha pere mpe na-aga n'ihu na-aghọ obere
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ị gara n'ihu site n'ọchịchọ nke uru na-ebelata naanị. Ọrụ quadratic na-agbanwe ntụziaka n'oge ụfọdụ, ya mere ịchọrọ ilele ma oge ahụ dị n'ime etiti.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Site na k ụfọdụ gaa n'ihu, ọ nwere ike ịkwụsị ịghọ obere
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Amụma a sitere n'icheta na eserese na-emeghe n'elu, ya mere ọ nwere isi kacha ala. Ebe isi kacha ala ahụ dị ga-elele site n'tebụl.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: K bụ gịnị, nke kacha pere mpe na-anọgide 0
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ị lere naanị uru dị n'ime etiti ma chee echiche banyere uru dị n'èzí ya. Mgbe etiti na-aghọ sara mbara, uru x ọhụrụ na-abata.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Nke a bụ tebụl uru maka k = 3 (0 ≤ x ≤ 3). Mgbe x = 1, f = 0; mgbe x = 2, f = −1; mgbe x = 3, f = 0. Ọzọkwa, mgbe x = 2.5, f = −0.75. Nke kacha pere mpe bụ −1.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ọ bụrụ na anyị abawanye k karịa, ruo k = 5 ma ọ bụ k = 10, gịnị ga-eme nke kacha pere mpe?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ebe f(x) = (x−2)² − 1, uru kacha ala −1 na-apụta na x = 2, ma maka x karịa 2 uru na-ebili ọzọ. Ya mere mgbe k bụ 2 ma ọ bụ karịa, nke kacha pere mpe bụ otu, −1. Ọ bụrụ na ị họọrọ a na mbụ, zoo aka na tebụl ole gbanwere amụma gị.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ọ na-aga n'ihu na-aghọ obere, dị ka −2, −3
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ị hụghị na uru na-ebili ọzọ mgbe ọ gafere x = 2. Tụnyere uru tupu na mgbe x = 2 n'tebụl.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ikpe a na-agụ site n'tebụl na uru dị ala kacha na x = 2 ma na-ebili mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Site na k = 3 gaa n'ihu, nke kacha pere mpe na-aghọ buru ibu n'ezie
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Mgbe etiti na-aghọ sara mbara, nke kacha pere mpe nwere ike ịghọ obere ma ọ bụ nọgide otu; ọ pụghị ịghọ buru ibu. Ị hapụrụ na uru niile sitere n'etiti gara aga ka gụnyere mgbe etiti na-aghọ sara mbara.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Maka k = 4 (0 ≤ x ≤ 4): mgbe x = 0, f = 3, ma mgbe x = 4, f = 3, ya mere ọnụ abụọ ahụ nwere otu uru. Nke kachasị bụ 3. Mgbe anyị gbasaara ruo k = 5, f = 8 na x = 5 na-aghọ nke kachasị ọhụrụ.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kedu ka a ga-esi dozie amụma Seoyeon “ọ bụrụ na etiti na-aghọ sara mbara, nke kachasị na-aghọ buru ibu”?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Maka 0 ≤ k ≤ 4, f(k) ≤ 3, ya mere nke kachasị bụ f(0) = 3, ma site na k > 4 gaa n'ihu, f(k) na-aghọ buru ibu karịa 3. Amụma Seoyeon ziri ezi naanị mgbe k < 2 maka nke kacha pere mpe, na naanị mgbe k > 4 maka nke kachasị. Oke ebe ọ ziri ezi na-ekewa dabere n'ọnọdụ (etiti).
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ozugbo k na-abawanye, nke kachasị na-abawanyekwa, ya mere Seoyeon ziri ezi dị ka ọ kwuru
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ị lelebeghị na nke kachasị na-anọgide 3 mgbe k = 3 na k = 4. Ịchọrọ itụnyere ma uru x ọhụrụ agbakwunyere na-enye ihe buru ibu karịa nke kachasị dị adị.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: N'agbanyeghị ole k na-abawanye, nke kachasị na-anọgide 3
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ị hapụrụ na f(5) = 8 na-apụta na k = 5. Ịchọrọ ilele ma uru n'ọnụ na-aga n'ihu na-eto.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ruo mgbe k rutere 4 nke kachasị na-anọgide 3, ma ọ na-eto naanị mgbe k gafere 4
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ikpe a na-atụnyere nke n'ime ọnụ abụọ, x = 0 na x = k, nwere uru buru ibu karịa.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.reflect: Ụfọdụ ndị buru ụzọ buru amụma “nke kacha pere mpe na-aga n'ihu na-aghọ obere” ma gbanwee echiche mgbe ha hụrụ tebụl gafere x = 2, ndị ọzọ buru amụma “ọ nwere ike ịkwụsị” ma debe amụma ahụ. N'otu ahịrị, kwuo tebụl nke gbanwere (ma ọ bụ debere) ikpe gị.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.prompt: N'ngalaba 0 ≤ x ≤ k, họrọ k nke (nke kachasị) − (nke kacha pere mpe) = 4. (k bụ ọnụọgụ n'ezie dị mma.)
z-m-38-01.s.s2.hint.0: Maka k = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, hazie nke kachasị na nke kacha pere mpe n'ime tebụl ma chọta ọdịiche.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.hint.1: Maa uru k ndị n'tebụl ebe ọdịiche bụ 4, ma nwalee ma ọ bụ otu maka k n'etiti (dị ka 2.5 na 3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.a: Ọdịiche bụ 4 naanị mgbe k = 4, ọ bụghịkwa maka k ọ bụla ọzọ
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.a: Ị lelere naanị na ọdịiche bụ 4 na k = 4 ma nwalebeghị uru ndị dị nso (dị ka 3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.b: Ọdịiche bụ 4 naanị mgbe k = 3, ọ bụghịkwa maka k ọ bụla ọzọ
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.b: Ị lelere naanị na ọ na-arụ ọrụ na otu uru ma nwalebeghị uru ndị gbara ya gburugburu.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.c: Ọdịiche bụ 4 maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie k ọ bụla bụ 4 ma ọ bụ karịa (site na k = 4 gaa)
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.c: Ị lelebeghị na na k = 5, nke kachasị bụ 8 ma nke kacha pere mpe bụ −1, ya mere ọdịiche bụ 9.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.d: Ọdịiche bụ 4 maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie k ọ bụla site na 2 ruo 4
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.d: Ikpe a chọtara oke ebe nke kacha pere mpe na-anọgide −1 ma nke kachasị na-anọgide 3 n'etiti.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.explain: Maka 2 ≤ k ≤ 4, nke kacha pere mpe bụ −1 (na x = 2) ma nke kachasị bụ 3 (na x = 0), ya mere ọdịiche bụ 4. Ọ bụrụ na k < 2, nke kacha pere mpe buru ibu karịa −1, ya mere ọdịiche erughị 4; ọ bụrụ na k > 4, nke kachasị f(k) buru ibu karịa 3, ya mere ọdịiche karịrị 4.

z-m-38-04.prereq.0: H1 nke ọrụ a bụ naanị ogo isi ike e kenyere n'mmepụta; ọ pụtaghị na usoro ọmụmụ na-etinye ọdịnaya a n'ogo 1 nke ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị. Were na a mụlarị ihe achọrọ tupu dị n'okpuru.
z-m-38-04.title: Ọ bụrụ na nkwupụta abụọ abụọ kwekọrọ n'ndekọ atọ niile, nke ka anyị kwesịrị ịtụkwasị obi na ya?
z-m-38-04.topic: Ịhọrọ nkwupụta na-adaba n'data (itụnyere inverse proportion na quadratic function)
z-m-38-04.goal: Tụnyere udi nkwupụta abụọ na-agafe otu ebe data atọ, kpebie nkwupụta kedu ị ga-atụkwasị obi na ya na ruo ebe ole site n'iji nha ọhụrụ na nhazi nke ọnọdụ, ma kwuo oke ị na-atụkwasị obi na ya.
z-m-38-04.material: A wụsara mmiri 12 L hà hà n'bottles x yiri ibe ha (x bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma), ma a tụrụ ọnụọgụ y (L) n'otu bottle. Ndekọ: na bottle 1, 12 L; na bottles 2, 6 L; na bottles 3, 4 L. Ndị enyi abụọ tụrụ aro nkwupụta. Jiwon: y = 12/x (gụọ: '12 kewara site n'x'). Hyunwoo: y = 2x² − 12x + 22 (gụọ: '2 x squared wepụ 12x gbakwunyere 22'). Mmiri anaghị asọpụta, a na-ekekwa ya hà hà n'bottles.
z-m-38-04.thinking.0: Ịgbakọ n'onwe gị iji lelee ma data na model kwekọrọ
z-m-38-04.thinking.1: Ịhazi ka ị si ekwere ihe ka ihe akaebe ọhụrụ na-abata
z-m-38-04.thinking.2: Ịkewa ihe na-adaba n'data na ihe na-adaba n'ọnọdụ
z-m-38-04.prereq.1: Ịchọta uru function (itinye x n'nkwupụta ma gbakọọ)
z-m-38-04.prereq.2: Ịgụ nkwupụta nke quadratic function na nke rational function y=k/x
z-m-38-04.prereq.3: Mmekọrịta (ọnụọgụ bottles) × (ọnụọgụ n'otu bottle) = ngụkọta ọnụọgụ
z-m-38-04.s.s1.prompt: Ịle naanị ndekọ atọ dị n'elu, họrọ nkwupụta kacha kwesị ekwesị.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye x = 1, 2, 3 n'nkwupụta abụọ ahụ nke ọ bụla ma tụnyere na ndekọ n'tebụl.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ma nkwupụta na-agafe ebe atọ bụ naanị otu, ma ọ bụ ma e nwere ike inwe ọtụtụ.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.a: y=12/x dị mfe karịa, ya mere ndekọ ndị a naanị zuru ezu iji kwubie na nkwupụta Jiwon ziri ezi
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.a: Ị jiri “nkwupụta dị mfe” dịka ihe akaebe. Ịdị mfe nwere ike ịbụ ihe kpatara ikwere, ma data anaghị ekpebi ya.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.b: y=2x²−12x+22 nwere coefficients ọnụọgụ zuru ezu niile ma ya mere ọ ziri ezi karịa, ya mere nkwupụta Hyunwoo ziri ezi
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.b: Ị chọrọ izi ezi n'udi nke coefficients. Ma nkwupụta na-adaba n'data enwere ike ịmata naanị site n'itinye uru.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.c: Nkwupụta abụọ ahụ kwekọrọ n'ndekọ atọ ahụ, ya mere ndekọ ndị a naanị apụghị ịgwa nke ziri ezi
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.c: Mkpebi a ghọtara na mgbe nkwupụta abụọ kwekọrọ n'otu data, data naanị apụghị ịkewa ha.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.d: Nkwupụta site n'ebe atọ bụ nke pụrụ iche, ya mere otu n'abụọ ahụ ga-enwerịrị njehie mgbakọ
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.d: Ị kwenyere na nkwupụta site n'ebe atọ bụ nke pụrụ iche. Ọbụlagodi na quadratic function na-agafe ebe atọ, udi nkwupụta dị iche nwere ike ịgafekwa otu ebe ahụ.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.explain: Itinye x = 1, 2, 3 na-enye 12, 6, 4 maka nkwupụta abụọ ahụ, nke kwekọrọ n'ndekọ. Ebe nkwupụta abụọ kwekọrọ n'otu data, ndekọ naanị apụghị ịkewa ha. Iji kpebie nkwupụta kedu ị ga-atụkwasị obi na ya, ị chọrọ ntọala ndị ọzọ, dịka nha ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ nhazi nke ọnọdụ.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi ọhụrụ otu otu. N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, kpebie ka nkwenye gị n'nkwupụta abụọ ahụ si agbanwe.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tinye ọnụọgụ bottles x e kpughere n'nkwupụta abụọ ahụ iji chọta uru a kọrọ n'onwe gị, ma tụnyere ha na uru e tụrụ.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mgbe uru e tụrụ dị iche n'ịkọ ihe, chee ma ohere abụọ ahụ: nkwupụta nwere ike ịbụ nke na-ezighị ezi, ma ọ bụ nha nwere ike ịbụ nke na-ezighị ezi.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.info: Anyị kewara mmiri n'bottles 4 ma tụọ ọnụọgụ n'otu bottle: ọ bụ 3 L.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.ask: Mgbe ị tụnyere uru e tụrụ a na ịkọ ihe nke nkwupụta abụọ ahụ, gịnị ka ị na-akwubi banyere nkwupụta abụọ ahụ?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.after: Nkwupụta Jiwon na-akọ 3 L n'x = 4, nke Hyunwoo na-akọkwa 6 L. 3 L e tụrụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta Jiwon ma dị iche nke ukwuu n'nke Hyunwoo. Ọ bụ ihe ezi uche dị na ya ịtụkwasị obi n'akụkụ Jiwon ozugbo, ọ bụkwa ihe ezi uche dị na ya itụ ọzọ otu ugboro n'ihi ohere nke njehie nha.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Nha nwere ike ịbụ nke na-ezighị ezi, ya mere tụọ otu ugboro ọzọ ma mgbe ahụ kpebie
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Nke a bụ àgwà nlezianya: ịghara ịgbaga n'nkwubi okwu site n'otu uru e tụrụ, kama ichọ ilele.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Mkpebi a na-atụkwasị obi karịa n'nke ịkọ ihe ya dị iche ntakịrị n'uru e tụrụ.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Mkpebi a elebeghị uru nkwupụta Hyunwoo na-enye n'x = 4.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.info: Na bottles 6 ọ tụrụ 2 L, na bottles 12 ọ tụrụ 1 L. (Ruo ugbu a, ndekọ 5.)
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.ask: Kedu ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị iji kwuo nkwenye gị n'nkwupụta Jiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.after: Ka data na-eto, nkwenye gị n'nkwupụta Jiwon na-eto. Ma ndekọ 5 naanị apụghị ịkwa nkwa maka x niile. Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ihe kpatara (nhazi nke ọnọdụ), nkwenye gị nwere ike ịdị ike karịa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Ndekọ 5 niile ziri ezi, ya mere anyị nwere ike ikwubi na ọ ziri ezi maka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma x ọ bụla
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Ị gbasara “ndekọ ndị ahụ ziri ezi ugboro ise” gaa n'ikpe niile. A lebeghị uru x ndị a tụghị.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Ọbụlagodi na ọnụọgụ ndekọ na-adaba na-abawanye, nkwenye anyị anaghị agbanwe ma ọlị
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Nke a atụleghị na nha ọhụrụ bụ ihe akaebe na-atụ aka n'otu ntụziaka.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Nkwenye anyị etola n'ihi na ndekọ 5 kwekọrọ, ma a ka chọrọ ihe kpatara dị iche ka ọ jide n'uru x ndị a tụghị
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Mkpebi a na-ekwu na ihe akaebe na-eme ka nkwenye sie ike, ma achọrọ ihe kpatara iji gbasaa gaa n'ikpe niile.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.info: Ọ bụrụ na ị mịkọrịta ọnụọgụ bottles site n'ọnụọgụ n'otu bottle, ị na-enweta mgbe niile ngụkọta 12 L. Nke a bụ n'ihi na mmiri anaghị asọpụta ma a na-ekekwa ya hà hà n'bottles.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.ask: Ịmara nke a, gịnị ka ị nwere ike ikwu banyere nkwupụta Jiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.after: Ebe x·y = 12, y = 12/x na-esite ozugbo n'ọnọdụ, ọ bụghị n'ndekọ. Ya mere anyị nwere ike ikwu na ọ na-ejide maka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma x ọ bụla n'okpuru echiche “mmiri anaghị asọpụta ma a na-ekekwa ya hà hà.” Ọ bụrụ na echiche agbaji (ọ bụrụ na mmiri na-asọpụta), nkwupụta na-agbanwekwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Ọ bụghị naanị n'ihi ndekọ kama n'ihi nhazi nke ọnọdụ, anyị nwere ike ikwu y=12/x maka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma x ọ bụla ma ọ bụrụ na mmiri anaghị asọpụta ma a na-ekekwa ya hà hà
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Mkpebi a na-edozi oke nkwenye site n'iji ihe kpatara abụọ ọnụ: ihe akaebe site n'data na nhazi nke ọnọdụ.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Anyị ga-adabere n'ndekọ 5 naanị, nhazi nke ọnọdụ abụghịkwa ntọala
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Ị hapụrụ na mmekọrịta na-esite n'ọnọdụ (ngwaahịa edoziri) na-ekpebi nkwupụta ozugbo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Nkwupụta Hyunwoo na-agafe ebe atọ n'ohere, ya mere nkwupụta Jiwon na-ezighị ezi
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Nkwupụta Hyunwoo ịgafe ebe atọ apụtaghị na nkwupụta Jiwon na-ezighị ezi. Nkwupụta ya anaghị ekwekọ n'nhazi n'uru x ndị ọzọ.
